title: 第二十三章 幻术异能第二十四章 他怎么会是这里的监狱长
slug: 共梦星际大佬后娇娇夜夜被宠哭
content_zh:
宴擎手里摇晃着一杯红酒，看着突然出现在自己床上的小雌性，微微挑眉。
这么漂亮干净的小雌性，头顶还顶着一对萌死人的兔耳朵，在恶魔星球这种地方简直比熊猫还稀有。
难道是哪个新来的女囚想减刑，自己偷偷跑来爬床的？
“小东西，为了减刑，胆子倒是不小。”
宴擎放下酒杯，起身走到床边。
他修长的手指挑起她的下巴，指腹摩挲着她细腻的肌肤，眼神玩味：“既然来了，就别想走了。”
沈如卿迷茫地看着他，那双湿漉漉的鹿眼眨了眨，似乎不明白为什么会出现在这里，又像是被吓傻了。
宴擎看着眼前这个美好得不像话的小雌性，眼底闪过一丝兴味。
但随着接触的深入，他敏锐地察觉到不对劲。
这触感虽然真实，但这气息，不像是实体入侵，更像是……某种高阶的精神体入梦？
还没等他做什么，人就消失不见了。
接下来的两晚，沈如卿都会准时且随机地出现在他的床上。
她根本无法控制梦境的落点，每次一闭眼，再睁眼就是这张奢华的红狐皮大床，和那个笑面虎一样的男人。
她不说话，只是用那双无辜的眼睛看着他。
或者在他靠近时瑟瑟发抖，露出脆弱的脖颈，那对兔耳朵更是随着心情变化而抖动，时而耷拉，时而竖起。
这种无声的诱惑，对于宴擎这种见惯了血腥与暴力的雄性来说，简直是致命的毒药。
到了第三晚。
宴擎终于确定了这是梦境。
看着怀中那个软糯糯的小东西，他眼底那种虚假的笑意终于褪去，取而代之的是真正的兴趣与浓烈的占有欲。
“小狐狸……抓到你了。”

红帐翻滚，九条蓬松巨大的红色狐尾凭空出现，紧紧缠绕着她的腰肢和四肢，将她死死禁锢在怀中，不留一丝缝隙。
宴擎低下头，在那张让他日思夜想的红唇上落下一吻，声音温柔得能滴出水来，却带着不容拒绝的霸道：“这一次，我不会再叫你跑了。”
他在她耳边低语，热气喷洒，看着她瞬间红透的兔耳朵，轻笑出声：“说，你在哪里？
哥哥我去接你过来，不叫你受罪，嗯？”
梦境之中，红帐翻滚。
沈如卿被他撩拨得浑身发软，整个人如同化作了一滩春水，只能无助地攀着他宽阔的肩膀，跟随着他的动作。
“唔……”
宴擎看着身下人儿那迷离的双眼，轻笑一声，那双桃花眼里满是细碎的星光与占有欲。
他低下头，吻住了她的唇，这一次，不再是试探性的浅尝辄止。
那是属于九尾天狐的掠夺。
他在梦境中彻底占有了她，动作温柔，对待她时也极度的有耐心，细心引导她接纳自己。
却又不容拒绝地步步紧逼，仿佛要在她灵魂深处打上属于九尾狐的专属烙印。
那一夜，沈如卿在极致的沉沦与战栗中，识海深处的粉色小兔子悄悄伸出了爪子，成功偷到了属于九尾狐的【幻术异能】。
清晨的第一缕阳光透过飞船的舷窗洒下，照亮了舱房内飞舞的尘埃。
沈如卿缓缓睁开眼，身体虽然酸软，但精神却异常亢奋。
她嘴角勾起一抹不易察觉的狡黠笑意，立刻闭目感应了一下体内。
只见识海中，那只粉色小兔子怀里除了雷电、金光、水球之外，此刻又多了一团淡淡的充满魅惑气息的粉色迷雾，是幻术异能！
content_en:
Yanqing shook a glass of red wine in his hand and raised his eyebrows slightly when he looked at the little female who suddenly appeared on his bed.
Such a beautiful and clean little female, with a pair of adorable rabbit ears on her head, is even rarer than a panda in a place like Demon Planet.
Could it be that some new female prisoner wanted to have her sentence reduced and secretly came to climb into the bed on her own?
"Young man, you are quite brave in order to reduce your sentence."
Yanqing put down his wine glass, stood up and walked to the bed.
His slender fingers lifted her chin, and his fingertips rubbed her delicate skin, his eyes playful: "Now that you're here, don't even think about leaving."
Shen Ruqing looked at him in confusion, blinking his wet deer eyes, as if he didn't understand why he was here, and he seemed to be frightened.
Yan Qing looked at the ridiculously beautiful little female in front of him, with a flash of interest in his eyes.
But as the contact deepened, he keenly sensed something was wrong.
Although this touch is real, this breath is not like a physical invasion, but more like... some kind of high-level spiritual body entering a dream?
Before he could do anything, the person disappeared.
For the next two nights, Shen Ruqing would appear on his bed on time and randomly.
She had absolutely no control over where her dreams would fall. Every time she closed her eyes, she would see this luxurious red fox fur bed and the smiling tiger-like man.
She didn't speak, just looked at him with those innocent eyes.
Or she would tremble when he came close, exposing her fragile neck, and her rabbit ears would tremble as her mood changed, sometimes drooping and sometimes standing up.
This silent temptation is simply fatal poison to a male like Yan Qing who is used to seeing blood and violence.
On the third night.
Yanqing finally confirmed that this was a dream.
Looking at the soft little thing in his arms, the fake smile in his eyes finally faded away, replaced by real interest and strong possessiveness.
"Little fox... I caught you."
The red tent rolled, and nine fluffy and huge red fox tails appeared out of thin air, tightly wrapping around her waist and limbs, trapping her tightly in his arms without leaving a single gap.
Yanqing lowered his head and placed a kiss on the red lips that made him think about it day and night. His voice was so gentle that it could make water drop, but it was overbearing and could not be refused: "This time, I won't ask you to run away again."
He whispered in her ear, spraying hot air, looking at her bunny ears that turned red instantly, and chuckled: "Tell me, where are you?
Brother, I will pick you up and won’t let you suffer, okay? "
In the dream, the red tent rolled.
Shen Ruqing was so teased that her whole body went limp, and her whole body seemed to turn into a pool of spring water. She could only helplessly cling to his broad shoulders and follow his movements.
"Well..."
Yanqing looked at the blurred eyes of the person under him and chuckled. Those peach blossom eyes were full of tiny stars and possessiveness.
He lowered his head and kissed her lips. This time, it was no longer a tentative taste.
That was the plunder of the Nine-tailed Sky Fox.
He completely possessed her in the dream, his movements were gentle, and he was extremely patient with her, carefully guiding her to accept him.
But she couldn't refuse and pressed forward step by step, as if she wanted to put the exclusive mark of the nine-tailed fox on her soul.
That night, when Shen Ruqing was in extreme despair and trembling, the little pink rabbit in the depths of the sea of ​​​​consciousness quietly stretched out its paws and successfully stole the [Illusion Power] belonging to the nine-tailed fox.
The first ray of sunlight in the morning shone through the portholes of the spacecraft, illuminating the dust flying in the cabin.
Shen Ruqing slowly opened his eyes. Although his body was sore, his spirit was extremely high.
An imperceptible sly smile appeared at the corner of her mouth, and she immediately closed her eyes and sensed the inside of her body.
In the sea, in addition to thunder, golden light, and water balls, the little pink rabbit had a faint pink mist full of charm. It was an illusion!
